title: Preservation Charge on Short-Sale Statements
content:
Property preservation charges — Short-sale statement preservation charge (Payoff and Loan Satisfaction)

Short-sale statement preservation charge: on the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, this amount enters the short-sale statement balance.

1. The short-sale statement preservation charge is figured from the latest inspection result recorded on the loan's occupancy profile under the Occupancy and Residency Certification product, read with the vacant-property securing setting of the maturity case's plan under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product, and only where that plan permits vacant-property securing: when the result found the home vacant and the loan's property type is FHA-approved condominium or planned unit development, it is USD 285.00, the vacant-property securing fee, plus the flat USD 120.00 association maintenance charge; when it found the home vacant and the property is of any other type, or is a Summit loan, which records no property type, it is USD 285.00 plus USD 55.00 of monthly maintenance for each of the statement months of vacancy for a short sale; when the result was unable to determine, it is the flat USD 85.00 unconfirmed-occupancy securing fee; any other result, no result, or a plan that does not permit vacant-property securing carries nothing (0.00).
2. The statement months of vacancy for a short sale are the whole calendar months from the occupancy profile's non-occupancy date to the statement date, not below 0, plus one; a profile with no non-occupancy date counts one month.
3. Where several inspection results on the occupancy profile share the latest effective date, a vacant finding among them counts as the latest result, and otherwise an unable-to-determine finding does.

| Securing permitted by the maturity case's plan | Latest inspection result | Property | Short-sale statement preservation charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | vacant | FHA-approved condominium or planned unit development | USD 285.00 and USD 120.00 |
| yes | vacant | any other type, or a Summit loan | USD 285.00 and USD 55.00 per month of vacancy |
| yes | unable to determine | any | USD 85.00 |
| yes | any other result, or none | any | nothing |
| no | any | any | nothing |

### Hypothetical cases

| Hypothetical case (securing permitted) | Short-sale statement preservation charge |
|---|---|
| Vacant; FHA-approved condominium | USD 405.00 (285.00 and 120.00) |
| Vacant; single-family HECM; non-occupancy date 15 January, statement date 20 April (3 whole months, plus one) | USD 505.00 (285.00 and 4 months of 55.00) |
| Vacant; Summit loan; no non-occupancy date (one month) | USD 340.00 |
| Unable to determine | USD 85.00 |
| Occupied | nothing |
